public_health_question.v: What is the status of the bioterrorism-related anthrax investigation, prophylaxis recommendations, and CDC assistance to other countries?

ev.q: This report updates the investigation of bioterrorism-related anthrax and the provision of antimicrobial prophylaxis to exposed persons
Investigation of a case of inhalational anthrax in a hospital stock room worker aged 61 years in New York City (NYC)
A 60-day course of antibiotics to prevent inhalational anthrax has been recommended for persons potentially exposed to Bacillus anthracis aerosols
Since November 7, 2001, CDC and state and local public health agencies have identified no new cases of bioterrorism-related anthrax.
During October 12--November 13, CDC received 111 requests from 66 countries.
CDC has assisted authorities in other countries investigating cases of bioterrorism-related anthrax.
surveillance for new cases of bioterrorism-related anthrax is ongoing in Delaware (DE), District of Columbia (DC), Florida (FL)
